description: Request the FREE Customized Fix Kit for a domain. There is one kit and it is free: eight fix files written from the site's ACTUAL content (Organization and FAQ JSON-LD, meta description, llms.txt, robots patch, Wikidata guide, Google Business checklist, README) plus a full PDF audit. Flow: pass the owner's email; Engagemii emails a verification link; after the owner clicks it the kit is built and the download link is emailed automatically. Kits are queued, so delivery is by email rather than in-chat. One kit per domain; repeat requests resend the stored kit.

email.description: The site owner's email (the verification link and the kit go there)

owner_confirmed.description: Confirm with the user that this is their own brand. Agencies working on client sites should use the data portal (engagemii.com/aeo/data) instead.
